# computesphere_notification_setting (Resource)

Manages a notification setting resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    computesphere = {
      source = "computesphere.com/computesphere/computesphere"
    }
  }
}

variable "api_token" {
  description = "API token for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Account ID for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
}

variable "api_url" {
  description = "API URL for ComputeSphere"
  type        = string
  default     = "api.computesphere.com"
}

provider "computesphere" {
  api_token  = var.api_token  # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_TOKEN env variable
  account_id = var.account_id # or set COMPUTESPHERE_ACCOUNT_ID env variable
  api_url    = var.api_url    # or set COMPUTESPHERE_API_URL env variable
}

resource "computesphere_notification_setting" "example" {
  email_enabled = true
  emails        = ["user@example.com"]
}

output "notification_setting_id" {
  value = computesphere_notification_setting.example.id
}

output "notification_setting_email_enabled" {
  value = computesphere_notification_setting.example.email_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `activity` (Boolean) Activity notification enabled.
- `billing` (Boolean) Billing notification enabled.
- `deployment` (Boolean) Deployment notification enabled.
- `email_enabled` (Boolean) Email notifications enabled.
- `emails` (List of String) List of email addresses for notifications.
- `inapp_enabled` (Boolean) In-app notifications enabled.
- `invites` (Boolean) Invites notification enabled.
- `payment` (Boolean) Payment notification enabled.
- `webhook_enabled` (Boolean) Webhook notifications enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the notification setting.
- `user_id` (String) User ID associated with the notification setting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to       = computesphere_notification_setting.example
  identity = { id = "n1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String)

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = computesphere_notification_setting.example
  id = "n1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell

terraform import computesphere_notification_setting.example n1a2b3c4-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab
```
